periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, with the longitudinal axes of the patches tilted approximately 45 degrees toward the midline of the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated ovoid shape with an approximate 2:1 length-to-width ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Marked tapering toward the inferior-medial terminus, creating a teardrop-like appearance.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The distance between the medial edges of the black pinna regions is approximately 1.5 times the width of an individual pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The superior boundaries of the ears are characterized by a smooth, continuous convex curvature.
